No. GUVI is not a business unit of HCLTech. Instead, it is part of the HCL Group, the parent group that also includes HCLTech among its companies. GUVI operates independently as an EdTech platform while benefiting from the HCL Group's strategic support, industry network, and ecosystem. Did HCL Group acquire GUVI? Yes. In September 2022, the HCL Group acquired a majority stake in GUVI, marking a significant milestone in the company's growth. The acquisition strengthened GUVI's ability to expand its learning ecosystem, develop industry-aligned programs, and scale its mission of delivering high-quality tech education in vernacular languages. What is the relationship between GUVI and HCLTech? GUVI is an HCL Group company, while HCLTech is one of the flagship companies within the same group.
